description: This file defines the GoalsRepository class, which provides an interface to access and modify goal data. It interacts with a local mock data source to retrieve and update goal models.

classes.name: GoalsRepository
classes.description: A repository class that manages goal data using a data source, providing methods to retrieve all goals and set a specific goal.

methods.name: GoalsRepository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with a data source.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all goal models from the data source.

methods.name: setGoal
methods.description: Updates or creates a goal with specified id, name, target, and current values via the data source.
